programs.name: European Design Awards
programs.bio: Annual pan-European competition for communication design, founded in 2007 by a network of European design magazines. Website: europeandesign.org

programs.name: Linotype Arabic Type Design Competition
programs.bio: International competition for Arabic typeface design organised by the German type foundry Linotype in the 2000s. Winning designs were developed and released as Linotype fonts.

programs.name: ADC Annual Awards
programs.bio: The Art Directors Club Annual Awards, founded in New York in 1921 and now run by The One Club for Creativity. Winners receive ADC Cubes. (Logo shown: The One Club.)

programs.name: Communication Arts Typography Competition
programs.bio: Annual juried typography competition held by Communication Arts magazine (USA); winning work, including typefaces, is published in the Typography Annual.

programs.name: Horouf Bilingual Type Design Competition
programs.bio: Type design competition for bilingual Arabic–Latin typefaces.

programs.name: Red Dot Award
programs.bio: International design award run by Design Zentrum Nordrhein Westfalen in Essen, Germany. Typefaces compete in the Brands & Communication Design category. Website: red-dot.org

programs.name: Dubai Lynx
programs.bio: Festival and awards for creativity in the Middle East and North Africa, held in Dubai since 2006 by the organisers of Cannes Lions. Website: dubailynx.com

programs.name: Tokyo TDC
programs.bio: Annual international awards of the Tokyo Type Directors Club, Japan, for typography and type design. Website: tokyotypedirectorsclub.org

programs.name: A’ Design Award
programs.bio: International juried design competition held annually in Como, Italy, across many design disciplines. Website: adesignaward.com

programs.name: Cannes Lions
programs.bio: Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity, held in Cannes, France, since 1954. Winners receive Gold, Silver and Bronze Lions. Website: canneslions.com

programs.name: German Design Award
programs.bio: International design award of the German Design Council (Rat für Formgebung). Website: german-design-award.com

programs.name: Premios CLAP
programs.bio: International design award (Premio Internacional de Diseño CLAP) based in Valencia, Spain, covering branding, graphic design and typography. Website: premiosclap.org

programs.name: The One Show
programs.bio: Annual awards for advertising, design and creativity run by The One Club for Creativity in New York. Winners receive One Show Pencils. (Logo shown: The One Club.)

programs.name: iF Design Award
programs.bio: International design award run by iF International Forum Design in Hanover, Germany, since 1954. Website: ifdesign.com
